summary: Magnite, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 7, 2026 disclosing Amendment No. 3 to its February 6, 2024 Credit Agreement, a routine debt repricing rather than a special situation. The amendment cuts the Term SOFR margin on term loans by 50 basis points to SOFR+2.50% and lowers the revolver margin to SOFR+2.50%-3.00% from SOFR+3.50%-4.00%. Morgan Stanley Senior Funding acts as term facility agent and Citibank as revolving/collateral agent. No board recommendation, ownership change, premium, or regulatory clock is involved; watch for interest savings and any further liability-management steps.
